summary: Created Cslib/Logics/Propositional/Semantics/Algebra/ConservativeChain.lean — a capstone module composing the full conservative extension chain IPL⟨→,⊤⟩ ⊂ IPL⟨∧,→,⊤⟩ ⊂ MPL ⊂ IPL ⊂ CPL. Includes derivability subsumption chain (ImpAxiom → IntPropAxiom → PropositionalAxiom), algebraic validity subsumption chain (HilbertValid → BrouwerianValid → GHAValid → HAValid → BAValid), inter-fragment conservativity corollaries (MPL conservative over IPL⟨∧,→,⊤⟩ and IPL⟨→,⊤⟩, ConjImp conservative over Imp), biconditional chain theorems, and ND corollaries. All proofs are 1-5 line compositions of existing results with no sorry. Builds cleanly. Axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound only.
